review.why: Codifies a brand's voice (register, tone spectrum, banned phrases, few-shots) and naming rules from its own published material.
review.summary: Gathers the brand's own published copy, names a register and tone spectrum, lists banned phrases, writes three to six before and after examples taken only from that material, and sets naming rules with approved and banned term tables. Claims found in samples are marked as needing a source, not encoded as brand fact. Output is staged for a narrative registry.
strengths: Examples come only from the brand's own text, never invented or copied from competitors
Naming rules with approved and banned term tables, each term labeled by origin
Decides how the brand speaks, not whether a claim is true
cautions: Stops without an upstream message house produced by another skill of the same suite
Registry, event-file and framework jargon hides the useful part
Titles and summaries mix English and Chinese
